# Best Law Firm Websites 2026: Our Top 10 Web Designs

![Black and white portrait image of Callum Hornigold.](/sites/default/files/styles/thumbnail/public/2024-04/callum.png?h=93c4deaf&itok=yY2t1Am4)

**Callum Hornigold, Head of Marketing Services** 31 October 2026

![best law firm web design](/cdn-cgi/image/format=webp,quality=90/sites/default/files/styles/hero_article/public/2025-03/featured.jpg)

Your law firm's website is one of the most important elements of your marketing arsenal.

It's your virtual front door – prospective clients will come knocking, and if they don't like what they see, they'll stroll down the street to your competitor's.

Today, the best law firm websites act as 24/7 marketing machines by attracting prospective clients, setting the right first impression, and encouraging them to convert.

A poorly designed website can instantly damage your credibility, while a strategic and engaging site can be a powerful tool for lead generation and building trust.

If you’re looking for some law firm website design inspiration, we've put together this list of the top law firm websites to demonstrate best-in-class web design.

From striking visuals and intuitive navigation to compelling content and optimised [law firm SEO](https://www.contra.agency/services/law-firm-seo-agency-london "Law firm SEO agency London"), these websites excel in various areas.

Explore what they have to offer and gain some law firm website ideas you can apply to your own design.

## Top 10 law firm website examples.

Each of these top law firm websites demonstrates unique strengths and offers valuable insight into what effective [legal web design](https://www.contra.agency/services/law-firm-website-design-agency-london "Law Firm Website Design Agency London") looks like.

This collection of law firm website examples highlights innovative designs and effective strategies that set them apart from the competition.

So, let’s examine the beautiful law firm websites raising the bar for online presence in the legal industry.

### #1 Hudgell Solicitors

![Hudgell Solicitors law firm website home page](/sites/default/files/inline-images/Screenshot%202025-03-28%20at%2016.37.19.png)

[**View the Hudgell Solicitors website**](https://www.hudgellsolicitors.co.uk/)

We’re kicking off our Top 10 best law firm web designs with one of Contra Agency’s very own, and for good reason. This [award-winning law firm website](https://www.contra.agency/insights/contra-agency-digital-impact-awards-2024 "Contra Agency claims three trophies at the Digital Impact Awards 2024.") doubled conversions year-on-year, making it a deserving contender.

Hudgell Solicitors is a leading law firm with offices in Hull, Manchester and London, specialising in various claim types such as personal injury, medical negligence, and civil liberties.

So what makes this one of the [best law firm web designs](https://www.contra.agency/insights/web-design-law-firms "Web Design For Law Firms: How To Generate More Clients.")?

Firstly, its friendly design reflects the firm’s down-to-earth Yorkshire roots, making the brand feel authentic and relatable.

Bright, contrasting colours are strategically placed throughout the design, further adding to the firm’s friendliness and approachability.

As well as making users feel welcome, the broad range of colours is used to clearly distinguish between different service areas, helping visitors to easily identify the specific information they require.

The structure of the site was created with the user journey firmly in mind. We used an optimised [law firm landing page structure](https://www.contra.agency/insights/law-firm-landing-pages-structure "Law Firm Landing Pages: What Is The Best Structure?") with a focus on intent throughout, ensuring pages flow naturally and answer key user questions at each stage.

This heavy focus on user experience is a key element of all the best law firm website designs.

Additionally, the site is highly optimised for conversions with a range of CTA buttons situated in prominent locations on different pages.

These include forms in the service page heroes, expandable callback forms within advice articles and easily accessible call buttons.

This brings us nicely on to Hudgell’s diverse array of website content, from helpful advice articles and popular, relevant news stories to inspiring client case studies.

Podcasts and informative videos are also featured, allowing the user to consume content in the way they find most engaging.

Combining these features helped the website win a Digital Impact Award for ‘Best Use of Digital in Professional Services’, cementing its position amongst the top law firm website designs.

### Need a lead-gen law firm website?

Contra can help you build a high-converting website like Hudgells. The site has converison rates above the benchmark and overtook Irwin Mitchell for both tracked keyword visibility and visibility in AI Overviews, showing how medium-sized firms can compete with large comeptitors if they choose the right web design & SEO partner.

[Get in touch](https://www.contra.agency/contact "Contact our London Digital Agency ")

### #2 Hugh James

![Hugh James law firm website home page](/sites/default/files/inline-images/Screenshot%202025-03-28%20at%2016.38.11.png)

[**View the Hugh James website**](https://www.hughjames.com/)

Next up, we have Hugh James, a Welsh law firm with offices in Cardiff, London, Manchester, Southampton and Plymouth.

The firm provides a comprehensive range of legal services to individuals, businesses, and public sector organisations.

Their innovative and creative design comfortably secures their spot amongst our 10 best law firm websites, and here’s why.

Immediately, the most eye-catching aspect of Hugh James' site is its unusual use of illustration.

Instead of relying on generic stock images, they've incorporated custom visuals that immediately grab the attention and communicate their brand identity.

This, along with a clean, modern sans-serif typography, creates a sophisticated and professional feel that firmly roots it in the top 10 best law firm website designs.

The use of minimal, 2D geometric motion graphics adds visual interest, bringing the site to life with a modern feel without distracting from the content that’s most important to the user.

The bold red colour palette is distinctive, contributing to a strong brand identity that users won’t easily forget.

Again, navigation is intuitive and straightforward to help users find the right information.

The website content is thorough, providing detailed information about their services, expertise, and team.
